miRNA expression (GEO **GSE154829**, 400 samples × 2102 miRNA) and asthma:
SVD, per-miRNA histograms, Bayesian logistic regression with ARD priors
(`logistic_ard`), a Gamma–Poisson model for the counts
(`gamma_poisson`), a self-organising map and Dirichlet-process mixture
clustering (`DPMMSubClusters`).

Source: `met_classification/nb_regression.jl` (models moved to `src/models.jl`;
`ard_logistic_regression.jl` contained only the model).

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Random, CategoricalArrays, LinearAlgebra, Distributions, Statistics, StatsBase
using Plots, Turing, ReverseDiff, GigaSOM
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
df   = read_arrow(datadir("GSE154829", "GSE154829_cov.arrow"));
mRNA = read_arrow(datadir("GSE154829", "GSE154829_miRNA.arrow"));
Mrna = permutedims(Matrix{Float64}(mRNA[:, 2:401]))      # samples × miRNA
```

## SVD and descriptives

```{julia}
#| eval: false
svd_mrna = svd(Mrna)
var_expl = svd_mrna.S .^ 2 ./ sum(svd_mrna.S .^ 2)
sum(var_expl[1:10])      # first 10 components explain ~98% of the variance
scatter(svd_mrna.U[:, 1], svd_mrna.U[:, 2], label = "")

Mrna_c = rescale(Mrna)
mv = DataFrame(media_ge = vec(mean(Mrna, dims = 1)), std_ge = vec(std(Mrna, dims = 1)))
scatter(mv[:, 1], mv[:, 2], label = "")
heatmap(cor(Mrna))
```

50-bin histogram counts of every miRNA:

```{julia}
#| eval: false
Dmat = hcat(string.(mRNA.Gene), zeros(size(Mrna, 2), 50))
Threads.@threads for i in 1:size(Mrna, 2)
    m, M = extrema(Mrna[:, i])
    h = StatsBase.fit(Histogram, Mrna[:, i], range(m, M; length = 51))
    Dmat[i, 2:51] = h.weights'
end
```

## ARD logistic regression for asthma

```{julia}
#| eval: false
asthma = df.asthma[1:400]
valid = .!ismissing.(asthma)
y = Int.(Array{Int64}(asthma[valid]) .>= 1)      # 0 = no, 1–2 = yes
x = Mrna_c[valid, :]

chain_lard = sample(logistic_ard(x, y), NUTS(; adtype = AutoReverseDiff(; compile = true)), 1500);
ard_res = chain_summary(chain_lard; pattern = "β₁")
sum(ard_res.nonzero)
```

## Gamma–Poisson model of the counts

```{julia}
#| eval: false
histogram(Mrna[:, 2], label = "observed")
histogram!(rand(Poisson(mean(Mrna[:, 2])), 400), color = "orange", label = "Poisson")

chain_gp = sample(gamma_poisson(permutedims(Mrna)), NUTS(), 1500);
```

## Self-organising map

```{julia}
#| eval: false
X = permutedims(x)
som = initGigaSOM(X, 10, 10)
som = trainGigaSOM(som, X)
tmp = mapToGigaSOM(som, X)
countmap(tmp.index)
e = embedGigaSOM(som, X)
scatter(e[:, 1], e[:, 2], label = "")
```

## Dirichlet-process mixture clustering

::: {.callout-warning}
`DPMMSubClusters.jl` is not in `Project.toml`: it pins old versions of JLD2,
Clustering and StatsBase and would hold the whole environment back (Turing
0.35, Flux 0.14, RxInfer 2, which do not load on current Julia). Run this
section in a separate environment with `] add DPMMSubClusters`.
:::

```{julia}
#| eval: false
using DPMMSubClusters, Random

function plot_dp_2d(pts, labels)
    plt = Plots.plot()
    Plots.plot!(pts[1, :], pts[2, :], seriestype = :scatter, color = Int64.(labels),
                markersize = 3, markerstrokewidth = 0.5, label = "")
    return plt
end

# simulated check
Random.seed!(1245)
xs, labels_s, clusters_s = generate_gaussian_data(10^4, 2, 6, 80.0)
plot_dp_2d(xs, labels_s)

# first two left singular vectors of the miRNA matrix
svd_met = svd(X)
pts = permutedims(svd_met.U[:, 1:2])
labels, clusters, weights = DPMMSubClusters.fit(pts, 1.0, iters = 100, seed = 1234)
plot_dp_2d(pts, labels)
```
